goal: Add suitable visual assets for every demonstration event and every demonstration user or contact.

success_criteria.description: Every displayed demonstration event has a suitable scene image mapped through a typed asset manifest with alt text, source label, and stable asset id.
Every displayed demonstration user or contact has an AI-generated-style avatar mapped through the same asset manifest with alt text, source label, and stable asset id.
Event list, event detail, contact list, contact detail, homepage activity, and recommendation cards use the manifest images without broken URLs or missing alt text.
Focused tests verify asset coverage for all displayed events, users, and contacts and fail when a new displayed record lacks an image mapping.
The asset documentation records generation prompts, licensing posture, replacement process, and the rule that generated media files live under public/orbit-demo-assets.

out_of_scope: Changing event or contact data semantics
